memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh Rule E scans the WHOLE file (all columns of a markdown table, not just prose) for [A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(sh|sql) tokens in README.md/EXTENSION.md/agents/*.md/skills/*/SKILL.md. When retiring a script from provides.scripts, rewording only a table's 'Reason'/description column while leaving the literal filename in the 'Artifact' column (e.g. a Deployment-Status 'Inactive' table) still trips Rule E once the manifest entry is gone -- the whole row (or at minimum the filename cell) must be removed or de-literalized (drop the .sh suffix), not just the surrounding prose.

check-extension-docs.sh Rule E (check_referenced_scripts_declared) scans README.md, EXTENSION.md, agents/*.md, and skills/*/SKILL.md (not .sh source files) for any [A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(sh|sql) token and FAILs if that token isn't declared in some extension's manifest.json provides.scripts/provides.hooks. When pruning a script from provides.scripts, all four doc-surface file types must be checked for lingering literal filename mentions, not just the primary README -- a plan that only edits README.md + manifest.json for a script removal will pass a naive read but regress this drift guard if EXTENSION.md/agents/*.md/SKILL.md still mention the old filename.

This repo's only existing 'quarantine, don't delete' directory convention is lua/neotex/deprecated/ (Neovim plugin configs), which uses a subdirectory + README documenting purpose/migration-status/removal-policy rather than in-place filename-suffix renaming. No .claude/-scoped quarantine convention exists yet; when pruning dead .claude/ scripts under QUARANTINE-NEVER-DELETE, mirroring this pattern (a scripts/deprecated/ subdirectory with git mv, preserving history) is preferable to a .removed-<UTC> suffix rename because it removes stale doc-string mentions cleanly rather than requiring careful literal-string rewriting to dodge doc-lint regex checks.
